<span class="sd">    capped at that same limit, spread out around the original spot so</span>
<span class="sd">    siblings (and any other point already on the map) stay at least</span>
<span class="sd">    ~spacing_meters apart - see _place_split_point()'s docstring for how.</span>
<span class="sd">    Every pop keeps its exact size - they're just divided up across more</span>
<span class="sd">    points near the original location. Mutates and returns `demand`.</span>

<span class="sd">    res_max_point_size/job_max_point_size are applied per-point based on</span>
<span class="sd">    _is_job_point() (jobs &gt; residents =&gt; job cap, otherwise residential cap)</span>
<span class="sd">    - see its docstring for the rare mixed-point tie-break. Independent caps</span>
<span class="sd">    (rather than one shared max_point_size) let job hubs and residential</span>
<span class="sd">    hubs be tuned separately - see RES_SIZE_RATIO/JOB_SIZE_RATIO in</span>
<span class="sd">    generate_demand_qzm_local.py.</span>

<span class="sd">    spacing_meters is a guess at a gap wide enough that two max-size circles</span>
<span class="sd">    won't visually overlap in-game - tune it up/down based on how it actually</span>
<span class="sd">    looks, since it depends on Subway Builder's own circle-size-vs-population</span>
<span class="sd">    scale, which isn't something we have visibility into from here.</span>

<span class="sd">    If `green_index` (a GreenSpaceIndex, built from OSM-captured park/</span>
<span class="sd">    nature_reserve/water_park/etc. polygons) is given, split siblings are</span>
<span class="sd">    also kept out of real green-space polygons, not just spaced apart from</span>
<span class="sd">    other points - see _place_split_point()'s docstring.</span>

<span class="sd">    Special demand points (universities, stadiums, etc.) are left alone -</span>
<span class="sd">    those are deliberately one single, real-world location with a</span>
<span class="sd">    researched capacity; splitting "Olympiastadion" into several scattered</span>
<span class="sd">    fake mini-stadiums would be wrong, not a fix.</span>
<span class="sd">    """</span>
    <span class="n">special_prefixes</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="nb">set</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">demand</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">special_demand_ids</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">keys</span><span class="p">())</span>
    <span class="n">pops_by_id</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">{</span><span class="n">p</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"id"</span><span class="p">]:</span> <span class="n">p</span> <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">p</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">demand</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"pops"</span><span class="p">]}</span>
    <span class="n">bbox</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="nb">getattr</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">demand</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s2">"bbox"</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="kc">None</span><span class="p">)</span>

    <span class="c1"># Seeded with every point on the map up front (not just this function's</span>
    <span class="c1"># own splits), and grown as new sub-points get placed, so a split's</span>
    <span class="c1"># sub-points never land on top of some unrelated, already-existing point</span>
    <span class="c1"># either - not just their own siblings.</span>
    <span class="n">ref_lat</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="nb">sum</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">p</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"location"</span><span class="p">][</span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">]</span> <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">p</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">demand</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"points"</span><span class="p">])</span> <span class="o">/</span> <span class="nb">len</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">demand</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"points"</span><span class="p">])</span>
    <span class="n">index</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">_SpatialIndex</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">demand</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"points"</span><span class="p">],</span> <span class="n">spacing_meters</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">ref_lat</span><span class="p">)</span>

    <span class="n">new_points</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">[]</span>
    <span class="n">split_count</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="mi">0</span>
    <span class="n">new_subpoint_count</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="mi">0</span>
    <span class="n">violations</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">[]</span>
    <span class="n">green_corrections</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">[]</span>
    <span class="n">total_orphaned_pop_ids</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="mi">0</span>
    <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">point</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">demand</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"points"</span><span class="p">]:</span>
        <span class="n">total</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">point</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"residents"</span><span class="p">]</span> <span class="o">+</span> <span class="n">point</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"jobs"</span><span class="p">]</span>
        <span class="n">max_point_size</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">job_max_point_size</span> <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">_is_job_point</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">point</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="k">else</span> <span class="n">res_max_point_size</span>
        <span class="n">prefix</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">point</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"id"</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">split</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">"_"</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">)[</span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">]</span>
        <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">total</span> <span class="o">&lt;=</span> <span class="n">max_point_size</span> <span class="ow">or</span> <span class="n">prefix</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">special_prefixes</span><span class="p">:</span>
            <span class="n">new_points</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">append</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">point</span><span class="p">)</span>
            <span class="k">continue</span>

        <span class="n">split_count</span> <span class="o">+=</span> <span class="mi">1</span>
        <span class="n">lon</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">lat</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">point</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"location"</span><span class="p">]</span>
        <span class="n">subs</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">[]</span>

        <span class="k">def</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf">_new_sub</span><span class="p">():</span>
            <span class="n">sub_lon</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">sub_lat</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">_place_split_point</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">index</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">spacing_meters</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">lon</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">lat</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="nb">len</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">subs</span><span class="p">),</span> <span class="n">bbox</span><span class="p">,</span>
                                                   <span class="n">violations</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">green_index</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">green_index</span><span class="p">,</span>
                                                   <span class="n">green_corrections</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">green_corrections</span><span class="p">)</span>
            <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">sub_lon</span> <span class="ow">is</span> <span class="kc">None</span><span class="p">:</span>
                <span class="c1"># Every candidate for a fresh sibling landed in green space</span>
                <span class="c1"># - fold into the most recently created sibling instead of</span>
                <span class="c1"># forcing this capacity into the park (or nudging it to the</span>
                <span class="c1"># park edge, which piles several such corrections on top of</span>
                <span class="c1"># each other there - see _place_split_point()'s docstring).</span>
                <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">subs</span><span class="p">:</span>
                    <span class="k">return</span> <span class="n">subs</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">]</span>
                <span class="c1"># No sibling exists yet either (the very first split</span>
                <span class="c1"># attempt failed) - only plausible if the ORIGINAL point</span>
                <span class="c1"># itself sits deep in/against a huge green area, which the</span>
                <span class="c1"># cluster_and_consolidate() green-space merge should</span>
                <span class="c1"># already have cleared before enforce_max_point_size() ever</span>
                <span class="c1"># runs. Fall back to the original spot unconditionally so</span>
                <span class="c1"># this population doesn't just vanish.</span>
                <span class="n">index</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">add</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">lon</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">lat</span><span class="p">)</span>
                <span class="n">sub</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">{</span>
                    <span class="s2">"id"</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="sa">f</span><span class="s2">"</span><span class="si">{</span><span class="n">point</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s1">'id'</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2">_split</span><span class="si">{</span><span class="nb">len</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">subs</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2">"</span><span class="p">,</span>
                    <span class="s2">"location"</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="p">[</span><span class="n">lon</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">lat</span><span class="p">],</span>
                    <span class="s2">"jobs"</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">,</span>
                    <span class="s2">"residents"</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">,</span>
                    <span class="s2">"popIds"</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="p">[],</span>
                <span class="p">}</span>
                <span class="n">subs</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">append</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">sub</span><span class="p">)</span>
                <span class="k">return</span> <span class="n">sub</span>
            <span class="n">sub</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">{</span>
                <span class="s2">"id"</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="sa">f</span><span class="s2">"</span><span class="si">{</span><span class="n">point</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s1">'id'</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2">_split</span><span class="si">{</span><span class="nb">len</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">subs</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2">"</span><span class="p">,</span>
                <span class="s2">"location"</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="p">[</span><span class="n">sub_lon</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">sub_lat</span><span class="p">],</span>
                <span class="s2">"jobs"</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">,</span>
                <span class="s2">"residents"</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">,</span>
                <span class="s2">"popIds"</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="p">[],</span>
            <span class="p">}</span>
            <span class="n">subs</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">append</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">sub</span><span class="p">)</span>
            <span class="k">return</span> <span class="n">sub</span>

        <span class="n">current</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">_new_sub</span><span class="p">()</span>
        <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">pop_id</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">point</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"popIds"</span><span class="p">]:</span>
            <span class="n">pop</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">pops_by_id</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">get</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">pop_id</span><span class="p">)</span>
            <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">pop</span> <span class="ow">is</span> <span class="kc">None</span><span class="p">:</span>
                <span class="c1"># A pop can be removed from demand["pops"] by depot's own</span>
                <span class="c1"># add_points() merge_within absorption without that removal</span>
                <span class="c1"># being reflected in every point's popIds list it touched -</span>
                <span class="c1"># same underlying depot behavior route_new_pops() already</span>
                <span class="c1"># works around (see its docstring). Simply dropping this</span>
                <span class="c1"># id here is correct, not a workaround: the pop no longer</span>
                <span class="c1"># exists, so there's nothing to carry into any new sub.</span>
                <span class="n">total_orphaned_pop_ids</span> <span class="o">+=</span> <span class="mi">1</span>
                <span class="k">continue</span>
            <span class="c1"># A pop can reference this point as BOTH residenceId and jobId</span>
            <span class="c1"># (depot's own cluster_points() can merge a residential and job</span>
            <span class="c1"># point together, producing a same-origin-same-destination</span>
            <span class="c1"># "self-loop" pop) - handle each role independently instead of</span>
            <span class="c1"># picking just one, or the unhandled side would keep pointing</span>
            <span class="c1"># at this now-deleted point.</span>
            <span class="n">is_residence</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">pop</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"residenceId"</span><span class="p">]</span> <span class="o">==</span> <span class="n">point</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"id"</span><span class="p">]</span>
            <span class="n">is_job</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">pop</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"jobId"</span><span class="p">]</span> <span class="o">==</span> <span class="n">point</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"id"</span><span class="p">]</span>
            <span class="n">size</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">pop</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"size"</span><span class="p">]</span>
            <span class="n">contribution</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">size</span> <span class="o">*</span> <span class="p">(</span><span class="nb">int</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">is_residence</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="o">+</span> <span class="nb">int</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">is_job</span><span class="p">))</span>

            <span class="n">current_total</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">current</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"residents"</span><span class="p">]</span> <span class="o">+</span> <span class="n">current</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"jobs"</span><span class="p">]</span>
            <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">current_total</span> <span class="o">+</span> <span class="n">contribution</span> <span class="o">&gt;</span> <span class="n">max_point_size</span> <span class="ow">and</span> <span class="n">current_total</span> <span class="o">&gt;</span> <span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">:</span>
                <span class="n">current</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">_new_sub</span><span class="p">()</span>

            <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">is_residence</span><span class="p">:</span>
                <span class="n">current</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"residents"</span><span class="p">]</span> <span class="o">+=</span> <span class="n">size</span>
                <span class="n">pop</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"residenceId"</span><span class="p">]</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">current</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"id"</span><span class="p">]</span>
            <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">is_job</span><span class="p">:</span>
                <span class="n">current</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"jobs"</span><span class="p">]</span> <span class="o">+=</span> <span class="n">size</span>
                <span class="n">pop</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"jobId"</span><span class="p">]</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">current</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"id"</span><span class="p">]</span>
            <span class="n">current</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"popIds"</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">append</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">pop_id</span><span class="p">)</span>

        <span class="n">new_points</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">extend</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">subs</span><span class="p">)</span>
        <span class="n">new_subpoint_count</span> <span class="o">+=</span> <span class="nb">len</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">subs</span><span class="p">)</span>

    <span class="n">demand</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"points"</span><span class="p">]</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">new_points</span>
    <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">split_count</span><span class="p">:</span>
        <span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="sa">f</span><span class="s2">"  -&gt; Split </span><span class="si">{</span><span class="n">split_count</span><span class="si">:</span><span class="s2">,</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2"> oversized point(s) into "</span>
              <span class="sa">f</span><span class="s2">"</span><span class="si">{</span><span class="n">new_subpoint_count</span><span class="si">:</span><span class="s2">,</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2"> smaller one(s)."</span><span class="p">)</span>
    <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">violations</span><span class="p">:</span>
        <span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="sa">f</span><span class="s2">"  [WARNING] </span><span class="si">{</span><span class="nb">len</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">violations</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="si">:</span><span class="s2">,</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2"> split sub-point(s) landed in an "</span>
              <span class="sa">f</span><span class="s2">"area too dense to keep </span><span class="si">{</span><span class="n">spacing_meters</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2">m clearance from every "</span>
              <span class="sa">f</span><span class="s2">"neighbor even after retrying (clearance found ranged "</span>
              <span class="sa">f</span><span class="s2">"</span><span class="si">{</span><span class="nb">min</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">violations</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="si">:</span><span class="s2">.0f</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2">-</span><span class="si">{</span><span class="nb">max</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">violations</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="si">:</span><span class="s2">.0f</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2">m) - these are the "</span>
              <span class="sa">f</span><span class="s2">"tightest spots on the map (very high real building density), "</span>
              <span class="sa">f</span><span class="s2">"not something more retries can fix."</span><span class="p">)</span>
    <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">green_corrections</span><span class="p">:</span>
        <span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="sa">f</span><span class="s2">"  -&gt; Folded </span><span class="si">{</span><span class="nb">len</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">green_corrections</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="si">:</span><span class="s2">,</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2"> split sub-point(s) into an "</span>
              <span class="sa">f</span><span class="s2">"already-placed sibling instead of placing them inside a "</span>
              <span class="sa">f</span><span class="s2">"green-space polygon (park/nature_reserve/water_park/etc.) they "</span>
              <span class="sa">f</span><span class="s2">"would otherwise have landed in."</span><span class="p">)</span>
    <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">total_orphaned_pop_ids</span><span class="p">:</span>
        <span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="sa">f</span><span class="s2">"  [WARNING] Skipped </span><span class="si">{</span><span class="n">total_orphaned_pop_ids</span><span class="si">:</span><span class="s2">,</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2"> popId(s) referencing "</span>
              <span class="sa">f</span><span class="s2">"a pop no longer in demand['pops'] (depot's own add_points() "</span>
              <span class="sa">f</span><span class="s2">"merge_within absorption can remove a pop without updating "</span>
              <span class="sa">f</span><span class="s2">"every point's popIds list that still names it - same "</span>
              <span class="sa">f</span><span class="s2">"behavior route_new_pops() already works around). Their "</span>
              <span class="sa">f</span><span class="s2">"population isn't lost - it was already accounted for "</span>
              <span class="sa">f</span><span class="s2">"wherever depot's absorption actually moved it; these are "</span>
              <span class="sa">f</span><span class="s2">"just stale leftover references being cleaned up here."</span><span class="p">)</span>
    <span class="k">return</span> <span class="n">demand</span>


<span class="c1"># Sensible per-type defaults for the add_points() knobs that OSM tags can't</span>
<span class="c1"># tell us. Any of these can be overridden per-entry in the JSON itself (e.g.</span>
<span class="c1"># a custom "merge_within" key on that entry).</span>
<span class="c1">#</span>
<span class="c1"># Only landmark types are listed here - sports_centre/park/port/college were</span>
<span class="c1"># dropped entirely (see special_demand_utils.py's module comment for why: the</span>
<span class="c1"># base pipeline already models these via CSV + is_special, and a second</span>
<span class="c1"># special-demand point for the same building just double-counted it).</span>
<span class="c1"># school/clinic stayed, but only reach here after passing a significance</span>
<span class="c1"># filter (also in special_demand_utils.py) that screens out the numerous</span>
<span class="c1"># small ones - same reasoning, scoped down instead of dropped entirely.</span>
<span class="n">TYPE_DEFAULTS</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">{</span>
    <span class="s2">"university"</span><span class="p">:</span>     <span class="p">{</span><span class="s2">"pop_size"</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="mi">100</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s2">"merge_within"</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="mi">300</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s2">"max_distance"</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="mi">25000</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s2">"residential_split"</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="mf">0.05</span><span class="p">},</span>
    <span class="s2">"hospital"</span><span class="p">:</span>       <span class="p">{</span><span class="s2">"pop_size"</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="mi">50</span><span class="p">,</span>  <span class="s2">"merge_within"</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="mi">200</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s2">"max_distance"</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="mi">20000</span><span class="p">},</span>
    <span class="s2">"school"</span><span class="p">:</span>         <span class="p">{</span><span class="s2">"pop_size"</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="mi">50</span><span class="p">,</span>  <span class="s2">"merge_within"</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="mi">200</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s2">"max_distance"</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="mi">15000</span><span class="p">},</span>
    <span class="c1"># clinic only ever reaches here after passing _clinic_is_significant() in</span>
    <span class="c1"># special_demand_utils.py (multi-doctor medical centers, not single-</span>
    <span class="c1"># practice offices) - scaled well below a full hospital.</span>
    <span class="s2">"clinic"</span><span class="p">:</span>         <span class="p">{</span><span class="s2">"pop_size"</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="mi">25</span><span class="p">,</span>  <span class="s2">"merge_within"</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="mi">150</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s2">"max_distance"</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="mi">10000</span><span class="p">},</span>
    <span class="s2">"stadium"</span><span class="p">:</span>        <span class="p">{</span><span class="s2">"pop_size"</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="mi">100</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s2">"merge_within"</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="mi">250</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s2">"max_distance"</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="mi">40000</span><span class="p">},</span>
    <span class="s2">"zoo"</span><span class="p">:</span>            <span class="p">{</span><span class="s2">"pop_size"</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="mi">50</span><span class="p">,</span>  <span class="s2">"merge_within"</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="mi">200</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s2">"max_distance"</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="mi">25000</span><span class="p">},</span>
    <span class="s2">"amusement_park"</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="p">{</span><span class="s2">"pop_size"</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="mi">50</span><span class="p">,</span>  <span class="s2">"merge_within"</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="mi">200</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s2">"max_distance"</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="mi">25000</span><span class="p">},</span>
    <span class="s2">"museum"</span><span class="p">:</span>         <span class="p">{</span><span class="s2">"pop_size"</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="mi">50</span><span class="p">,</span>  <span class="s2">"merge_within"</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="mi">150</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s2">"max_distance"</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="mi">20000</span><span class="p">},</span>
    <span class="c1"># Airport passenger demand: merge_within intentionally omitted/0 so this</span>
    <span class="c1"># does NOT absorb the existing, separate CSV-driven airport *worker*</span>
    <span class="c1"># mega-hub (custom_hubs.json / AIRPORT_GEOJSON) - those stay unmerged.</span>
    <span class="s2">"airport"</span><span class="p">:</span>        <span class="p">{</span><span class="s2">"pop_size"</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="mi">200</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s2">"merge_within"</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">,</span>   <span class="s2">"max_distance"</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="kc">None</span><span class="p">},</span>
<span class="p">}</span>
<span class="n">FALLBACK_DEFAULTS</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">{</span><span class="s2">"pop_size"</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="mi">50</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s2">"merge_within"</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="mi">200</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s2">"max_distance"</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="mi">25000</span><span class="p">}</span>

<span class="c1"># depot itself only recognizes the fixed taxonomy shipped in</span>
<span class="c1"># src/depot/special_demand_types.json (parent type ids, plus a handful of</span>
<span class="c1"># registered sub_type ids). Any poi "type" add_points() is given that isn't</span>
<span class="c1"># in that taxonomy gets accepted silently at add_points() time, but then</span>
<span class="c1"># crashes save_schemas() with a KeyError later</span>
<span class="c1"># (self.special_demand_subtypes[p['type']]) once you try to actually save.</span>
<span class="c1"># This remaps a label to the closest real depot type/subtype id at the</span>
<span class="c1"># hand-off - university, hospital, school, stadium, museum, zoo,</span>
<span class="c1"># amusement_park, and airport already match depot's taxonomy directly and</span>
<span class="c1"># need no remapping. "clinic" is the one exception: it isn't in depot's</span>
<span class="c1"># taxonomy at all (neither a parent id nor a registered subtype, and</span>
<span class="c1"># depot's "hospital" has no subtypes to attach it to either), so it's</span>
<span class="c1"># remapped to "hospital" outright.</span>
<span class="n">DEPOT_TYPE_OVERRIDES</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">{</span>
    <span class="s2">"clinic"</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="s2">"hospital"</span><span class="p">,</span>
<span class="p">}</span>


<span class="k">def</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf">_print_type_breakdown</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">header</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">type_labels</span><span class="p">):</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="sd">"""Prints a header line then a multi-line, indented 'type  count'</span>
<span class="sd">    breakdown (one type per line, most common first, counts right-aligned) -</span>
<span class="sd">    instead of printing one line per entry, which is unreadable once a city</span>
<span class="sd">    has hundreds."""</span>
    <span class="k">if</span> <span class="ow">not</span> <span class="n">type_labels</span><span class="p">:</span>
        <span class="k">return</span>
    <span class="n">counts</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">{}</span>
    <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">t</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">type_labels</span><span class="p">:</span>
        <span class="n">counts</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n">t</span><span class="p">]</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">counts</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">get</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">t</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="o">+</span> <span class="mi">1</span>
    <span class="n">name_width</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="nb">max</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="nb">len</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">t</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">t</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">counts</span><span class="p">)</span>
    <span class="n">rows</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="nb">sorted</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">counts</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">items</span><span class="p">(),</span> <span class="n">key</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="k">lambda</span> <span class="n">kv</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="o">-</span><span class="n">kv</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">])</span>
    <span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="sa">f</span><span class="s2">"</span><span class="si">{</span><span class="n">header</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2"> (</span><span class="si">{</span><span class="nb">len</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">type_labels</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="si">:</span><span class="s2">,</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2"> total):"</span><span class="p">)</span>
    <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">t</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">n</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">rows</span><span class="p">:</span>
        <span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="sa">f</span><span class="s2">"    </span><span class="si">{</span><span class="n">t</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">ljust</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">name_width</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2">  </span><span class="si">{</span><span class="n">n</span><span class="si">:</span><span class="s2">&gt;5,</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2">"</span><span class="p">)</span>


<span class="k">def</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf">_haversine_m</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">lon1</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">lat1</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">lon2</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">lat2</span><span class="p">):</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="sd">"""Great-circle distance in meters - same formula as depot's own</span>
<span class="sd">    src/depot/utils.py:haversine(), duplicated here since that's a private</span>
<span class="sd">    helper inside src/depot we don't import from directly."""</span>
    <span class="n">lon1</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">lat1</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">lon2</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">lat2</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="nb">map</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">math</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">radians</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="p">[</span><span class="n">lon1</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">lat1</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">lon2</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">lat2</span><span class="p">])</span>
    <span class="n">dlon</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">lon2</span> <span class="o">-</span> <span class="n">lon1</span>
    <span class="n">dlat</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">lat2</span> <span class="o">-</span> <span class="n">lat1</span>
    <span class="n">a</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">math</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">sin</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">dlat</span> <span class="o">/</span> <span class="mi">2</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="o">**</span> <span class="mi">2</span> <span class="o">+</span> <span class="n">math</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">cos</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">lat1</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="o">*</span> <span class="n">math</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">cos</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">lat2</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="o">*</span> <span class="n">math</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">sin</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">dlon</span> <span class="o">/</span> <span class="mi">2</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="o">**</span> <span class="mi">2</span>
    <span class="k">return</span> <span class="mi">2</span> <span class="o">*</span> <span class="n">math</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">asin</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">math</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">sqrt</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">a</span><span class="p">))</span> <span class="o">*</span> <span class="mi">6371000</span>


<span class="k">def</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf">_clear_ordinary_points_within</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">demand</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">location</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">radius_meters</span><span class="p">):</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="sd">"""</span>
<span class="sd">    Deletes any ORDINARY (non-special-demand) point within radius_meters of</span>
<span class="sd">    location, along with its pops - same bookkeeping as depot's own</span>
<span class="sd">    del_points() (cleans up the *other* endpoint's popIds reference for each</span>
<span class="sd">    removed pop too), just bulk-selecting everything within a radius instead</span>
<span class="sd">    of only the single nearest point per coordinate.</span>

<span class="sd">    Call this right before add_points() instead of relying on its own</span>
<span class="sd">    merge_within to do the absorption: add_points()'s merge_within ADDS an</span>
<span class="sd">    absorbed point's existing jobs/residents onto the new special demand</span>
<span class="sd">    point, on top of the freshly generated capacity-based pops - i.e. it's</span>
<span class="sd">    additive, not a replacement. For a landmark with a real, researched</span>
<span class="sd">    total_capacity, that means the final point ends up bigger than the</span>
<span class="sd">    number you actually typed in (typed number + whatever the base pipeline</span>
<span class="sd">    already modeled at that same spot - verified on real data: Uber Arena's</span>
<span class="sd">    total_capacity=14500 came out as 16,661; a university auto-filled at</span>
<span class="sd">    4,510 came out as 13,800 jobs alone). Deleting the ordinary point first</span>
<span class="sd">    means the new special demand point starts clean, so total_capacity is</span>
<span class="sd">    what actually lands in the file.</span>

<span class="sd">    Mirrors add_points()'s own protection against ever merging two DIFFERENT</span>
<span class="sd">    special demand points together (checking each point id's prefix against</span>
<span class="sd">    demand.special_demand_ids) - so this never touches another special</span>
<span class="sd">    demand point, only ordinary base-pipeline points.</span>
<span class="sd">    """</span>
    <span class="k">if</span> <span class="ow">not</span> <span class="n">radius_meters</span><span class="p">:</span>
        <span class="k">return</span> <span class="mi">0</span>

    <span class="n">special_prefixes</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="nb">set</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">demand</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">special_demand_ids</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">keys</span><span class="p">())</span>
    <span class="n">lon</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">lat</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">location</span>

    <span class="n">remove_ids</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">{</span>
        <span class="n">p</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"id"</span><span class="p">]</span> <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">p</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">demand</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"points"</span><span class="p">]</span>
        <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">p</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"id"</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">split</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">"_"</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">)[</span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">]</span> <span class="ow">not</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">special_prefixes</span>
        <span class="ow">and</span> <span class="n">_haversine_m</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">lon</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">lat</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">p</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"location"</span><span class="p">][</span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">],</span> <span class="n">p</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"location"</span><span class="p">][</span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">])</span> <span class="o">&lt;=</span> <span class="n">radius_meters</span>
    <span class="p">}</span>
    <span class="k">if</span> <span class="ow">not</span> <span class="n">remove_ids</span><span class="p">:</span>
        <span class="k">return</span> <span class="mi">0</span>

    <span class="n">points_by_id</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">{</span><span class="n">p</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"id"</span><span class="p">]:</span> <span class="n">p</span> <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">p</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">demand</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"points"</span><span class="p">]}</span>
    <span class="n">pops_by_id</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">{</span><span class="n">p</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"id"</span><span class="p">]:</span> <span class="n">p</span> <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">p</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">demand</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"pops"</span><span class="p">]}</span>

    <span class="n">pops_to_remove</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="nb">set</span><span class="p">()</span>
    <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">pid</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">remove_ids</span><span class="p">:</span>
        <span class="n">pops_to_remove</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">update</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">points_by_id</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n">pid</span><span class="p">][</span><span class="s2">"popIds"</span><span class="p">])</span>

    <span class="c1"># Clean up the *other* endpoint's popIds list AND its residents/jobs</span>
    <span class="c1"># count for each removed pop (only if that endpoint isn't also being</span>
    <span class="c1"># deleted) - removing just the popIds entry without also subtracting the</span>
    <span class="c1"># pop's size left the other point's residents/jobs stale/inflated,</span>
    <span class="c1"># exactly the kind of drift that shows up as print_stats()'s "Workers"</span>
    <span class="c1"># and "Residents" totals no longer matching the sum of all pop sizes.</span>
    <span class="c1">#</span>
    <span class="c1"># pops_by_id.get() (not direct indexing): this runs once per landmark</span>
    <span class="c1"># in add_named_special_demand()'s loop, so by the time a LATER</span>
    <span class="c1"># landmark's call gets here, an EARLIER landmark's demand.add_points()</span>
    <span class="c1"># may have already absorbed/deleted a pop via depot's own internal</span>
    <span class="c1"># merge_within logic without updating every point's popIds list that</span>
    <span class="c1"># still references it (same underlying depot behavior route_new_pops()</span>
    <span class="c1"># already works around) - a stale pop_id here is simply skipped rather</span>
    <span class="c1"># than crashing, since there's nothing left to clean up for it.</span>
    <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">pop_id</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">pops_to_remove</span><span class="p">:</span>
        <span class="n">pop</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">pops_by_id</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">get</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">pop_id</span><span class="p">)</span>
        <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">pop</span> <span class="ow">is</span> <span class="kc">None</span><span class="p">:</span>
            <span class="k">continue</span>
        <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">role</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">"residenceId"</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s2">"jobId"</span><span class="p">):</span>
            <span class="n">other_id</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">pop</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n">role</span><span class="p">]</span>
            <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">other_id</span> <span class="ow">not</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">remove_ids</span><span class="p">:</span>
                <span class="n">other_point</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">points_by_id</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">get</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">other_id</span><span class="p">)</span>
                <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">other_point</span> <span class="ow">is</span> <span class="ow">not</span> <span class="kc">None</span> <span class="ow">and</span> <span class="n">pop_id</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">other_point</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"popIds"</span><span class="p">]:</span>
                    <span class="n">other_point</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"popIds"</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">remove</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">pop_id</span><span class="p">)</span>
                    <span class="n">field</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="s2">"residents"</span> <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">role</span> <span class="o">==</span> <span class="s2">"residenceId"</span> <span class="k">else</span> <span class="s2">"jobs"</span>
                    <span class="n">other_point</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n">field</span><span class="p">]</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="nb">max</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">other_point</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n">field</span><span class="p">]</span> <span class="o">-</span> <span class="n">pop</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"size"</span><span class="p">])</span>

    <span class="n">demand</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"pops"</span><span class="p">]</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">[</span><span class="n">p</span> <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">p</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">demand</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"pops"</span><span class="p">]</span> <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">p</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"id"</span><span class="p">]</span> <span class="ow">not</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">pops_to_remove</span><span class="p">]</span>
    <span class="n">demand</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"points"</span><span class="p">]</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">[</span><span class="n">p</span> <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">p</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">demand</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"points"</span><span class="p">]</span> <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">p</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"id"</span><span class="p">]</span> <span class="ow">not</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">remove_ids</span><span class="p">]</span>

    <span class="k">return</span> <span class="nb">len</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">remove_ids</span><span class="p">)</span>


<span class="k">def</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf">_predict_point_id</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">demand</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">poi</span><span class="p">):</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="sd">"""Predicts the point ID depot's add_points() would generate for this</span>
<span class="sd">    poi, mirroring add_points()'s own internal ID derivation exactly."""</span>
    <span class="n">poi_type</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">poi</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"type"</span><span class="p">]</span>
    <span class="n">schema_code</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">demand</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">special_demand_codes</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">get</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">poi_type</span><span class="p">)</span>
    <span class="n">type_code</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">schema_code</span> <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">schema_code</span> <span class="k">else</span> <span class="n">poi_type</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">replace</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">" "</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s2">"_"</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">upper</span><span class="p">()</span>
    <span class="n">identifier</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">poi</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">get</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">"code"</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="ow">or</span> <span class="n">poi</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"name"</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">replace</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">" "</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s2">"_"</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">strip</span><span class="p">()</span>
    <span class="k">return</span> <span class="sa">f</span><span class="s2">"</span><span class="si">{</span><span class="n">type_code</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2">_</span><span class="si">{</span><span class="n">identifier</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2">"</span>


<span class="k">def</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf">add_named_special_demand</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">demand</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">entries</span><span class="p">):</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="sd">"""</span>
<span class="sd">    Calls demand.add_points() once per entry - skipping any entry whose</span>
<span class="sd">    predicted point ID already exists in demand['points']. add_points()</span>
<span class="sd">    itself doesn't check for an existing point with the same ID before</span>
<span class="sd">    appending, so re-running this against an already-enriched file (e.g.</span>
<span class="sd">    re-running `python run_demand_pipeline.py --stage demand` more than</span>
<span class="sd">    once, or any future workflow that reuses a file across runs) would</span>
<span class="sd">    otherwise create a duplicate point for the same real-world landmark</span>
<span class="sd">    every time.</span>

<span class="sd">    Only pass entries that already have a non-null total_capacity (see</span>
<span class="sd">    special_demand_utils.detect_and_confirm_special_demand).</span>
<span class="sd">    Returns the list of poi dicts actually passed to add_points(), for logging/inspection.</span>
<span class="sd">    """</span>
    <span class="n">existing_ids</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">{</span><span class="n">p</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"id"</span><span class="p">]</span> <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">p</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">demand</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"points"</span><span class="p">]}</span>
    <span class="n">added</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">[]</span>
    <span class="n">added_types</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">[]</span>
    <span class="n">skipped_types</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">[]</span>
    <span class="n">cleared_count</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="mi">0</span>

    <span class="n">total</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="nb">len</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">entries</span><span class="p">)</span>
    <span class="c1"># add_points() recomputes gravity weights over every existing point on</span>
    <span class="c1"># each call, so a few thousand entries can take a while - show progress</span>
    <span class="c1"># every ~1/15th instead of going silent the whole time (without also</span>
    <span class="c1"># spamming the console the way per-entry printing did before).</span>
    <span class="n">progress_interval</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="nb">max</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">total</span> <span class="o">//</span> <span class="mi">15</span><span class="p">)</span>

    <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">i</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">entry</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="nb">enumerate</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">entries</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">):</span>
        <span class="n">type_label</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">entry</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"type"</span><span class="p">]</span>
        <span class="n">defaults</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">TYPE_DEFAULTS</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">get</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">type_label</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">FALLBACK_DEFAULTS</span><span class="p">)</span>

        <span class="n">poi</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">{</span>
            <span class="s2">"type"</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="n">DEPOT_TYPE_OVERRIDES</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">get</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">type_label</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">type_label</span><span class="p">),</span>
            <span class="s2">"name"</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="n">entry</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"name"</span><span class="p">],</span>
            <span class="s2">"location"</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="n">entry</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"location"</span><span class="p">],</span>
            <span class="s2">"total_capacity"</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="n">entry</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"total_capacity"</span><span class="p">],</span>
            <span class="s2">"pop_size"</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="n">entry</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">get</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">"pop_size"</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">defaults</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"pop_size"</span><span class="p">]),</span>
        <span class="p">}</span>
        <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">entry</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">get</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">"code"</span><span class="p">):</span>
            <span class="n">poi</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"code"</span><span class="p">]</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">entry</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"code"</span><span class="p">]</span>

        <span class="n">predicted_id</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">_predict_point_id</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">demand</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">poi</span><span class="p">)</span>
        <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">predicted_id</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">existing_ids</span><span class="p">:</span>
            <span class="n">skipped_types</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">append</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">type_label</span><span class="p">)</span>
            <span class="k">continue</span>

        <span class="n">merge_within</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">entry</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">get</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">"merge_within"</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">defaults</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">get</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">"merge_within"</span><span class="p">))</span>
        <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">merge_within</span><span class="p">:</span>  <span class="c1"># skip 0/None - see the "airport" note above</span>
            <span class="n">poi</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"merge_within"</span><span class="p">]</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">merge_within</span>
            <span class="c1"># Pre-clear ordinary points within this radius ourselves instead</span>
            <span class="c1"># of letting add_points()'s own merge_within absorb-and-ADD them</span>
            <span class="c1"># onto total_capacity - see _clear_ordinary_points_within()'s</span>
            <span class="c1"># docstring for why.</span>
            <span class="n">cleared_count</span> <span class="o">+=</span> <span class="n">_clear_ordinary_points_within</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">demand</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">entry</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"location"</span><span class="p">],</span> <span class="n">merge_within</span><span class="p">)</span>

        <span class="n">max_distance</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">entry</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">get</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">"max_distance"</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">defaults</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">get</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">"max_distance"</span><span class="p">))</span>
        <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">max_distance</span><span class="p">:</span>
            <span class="n">poi</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"max_distance"</span><span class="p">]</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">max_distance</span>

        <span class="n">residential_split</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">entry</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">get</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">"residential_split"</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">defaults</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">get</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">"residential_split"</span><span class="p">))</span>
        <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">residential_split</span><span class="p">:</span>
            <span class="n">poi</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"residential_split"</span><span class="p">]</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">residential_split</span>

        <span class="n">demand</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">add_points</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">poi</span><span class="p">)</span>
        <span class="n">existing_ids</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">add</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">predicted_id</span><span class="p">)</span>
        <span class="n">added</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">append</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">poi</span><span class="p">)</span>
        <span class="n">added_types</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">append</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">type_label</span><span class="p">)</span>

        <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">i</span> <span class="o">%</span> <span class="n">progress_interval</span> <span class="o">==</span> <span class="mi">0</span> <span class="ow">or</span> <span class="n">i</span> <span class="o">==</span> <span class="n">total</span><span class="p">:</span>
            <span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="sa">f</span><span class="s2">"    -&gt; </span><span class="si">{</span><span class="n">i</span><span class="si">:</span><span class="s2">,</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2"> / </span><span class="si">{</span><span class="n">total</span><span class="si">:</span><span class="s2">,</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2"> processed..."</span><span class="p">)</span>

    <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">skipped_types</span><span class="p">:</span>
        <span class="n">_print_type_breakdown</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">"Skipping (already present in the demand file)"</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">skipped_types</span><span class="p">)</span>
    <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">added_types</span><span class="p">:</span>
        <span class="n">_print_type_breakdown</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">"Adding special demand point(s)"</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">added_types</span><span class="p">)</span>
    <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">cleared_count</span><span class="p">:</span>
        <span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="sa">f</span><span class="s2">"  Cleared </span><span class="si">{</span><span class="n">cleared_count</span><span class="si">:</span><span class="s2">,</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2"> ordinary point(s) that would otherwise have "</span>
              <span class="sa">f</span><span class="s2">"been absorbed on top of a landmark's total_capacity instead of replaced."</span><span class="p">)</span>

    <span class="k">return</span> <span class="n">added</span>


<span class="c1"># depot's own demand.calculate_routes(routing_method="osrm") is single-</span>
<span class="c1"># threaded and, per point in the WHOLE file (not just new ones), makes a</span>
<span class="c1"># "nearest" HTTP round trip for the home node, then for each of that point's</span>
<span class="c1"># still-unrouted pops another "nearest" round trip for the job node plus the</span>
<span class="c1"># route call itself - three sequential requests per pop, each preceded by a</span>
<span class="c1"># small sleep, with no concurrency at all. On a file with tens of thousands</span>
<span class="c1"># of points that's extremely slow even though only a handful of pops (the</span>
<span class="c1"># ones add_points() just created, which always start at drivingSeconds=0)</span>
<span class="c1"># actually need anything computed.</span>
<span class="c1">#</span>
<span class="c1"># route_new_pops() instead batches many pairs into OSRM's /table endpoint at</span>
<span class="c1"># once (a many-to-many duration/distance matrix in a single request) instead</span>
<span class="c1"># of one /route call per pop - same approach and same tuning as</span>
<span class="c1"># generate_demand_qzm_local.py's base ~126k-route commuter routing, where</span>
<span class="c1"># measuring real BER data found batch_size=5 beat both no batching (all</span>
<span class="c1"># per-request overhead) and much bigger batches (too much wasted matrix</span>
<span class="c1"># compute once OSRM was shown to be CPU-saturated, not overhead-bound).</span>
<span class="k">def</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf">route_new_pops</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">demand</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">osrm_url</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">max_workers</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="mi">30</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">batch_size</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="mi">5</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">max_retry_passes</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="mi">5</span><span class="p">):</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="sd">"""</span>
<span class="sd">    Resolves drivingSeconds/drivingDistance for any pop that still has</span>
<span class="sd">    drivingSeconds &lt;= 0 (i.e. newly created by add_points()). Mutates</span>
<span class="sd">    `demand` in place. Returns the number of pops routed.</span>
<span class="sd">    """</span>
    <span class="n">points_by_id</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">{</span><span class="n">p</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"id"</span><span class="p">]:</span> <span class="n">p</span> <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">p</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">demand</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"points"</span><span class="p">]}</span>

    <span class="n">unrouted</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">[</span><span class="n">p</span> <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">p</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">demand</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"pops"</span><span class="p">]</span> <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">p</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">get</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">"drivingSeconds"</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="o">&lt;=</span> <span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">]</span>
    <span class="c1"># A pop can end up pointing at a point ID that add_points()'s own</span>
    <span class="c1"># merge_within absorption already deleted (e.g. two special demand</span>
    <span class="c1"># entries both merge-absorbing a shared nearby cluster point - depot's</span>
    <span class="c1"># own bookkeeping for that case doesn't always catch every pop</span>
    <span class="c1"># referencing it). demand.save() drops these automatically via its own</span>
    <span class="c1"># sanitize() step regardless, so just skip them here rather than crash.</span>
    <span class="n">to_route</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">[</span><span class="n">p</span> <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">p</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">unrouted</span> <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">p</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"residenceId"</span><span class="p">]</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">points_by_id</span> <span class="ow">and</span> <span class="n">p</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"jobId"</span><span class="p">]</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">points_by_id</span><span class="p">]</span>
    <span class="n">orphaned</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="nb">len</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">unrouted</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="o">-</span> <span class="nb">len</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">to_route</span><span class="p">)</span>
    <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">orphaned</span><span class="p">:</span>
        <span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="sa">f</span><span class="s2">"  [WARNING] Skipping </span><span class="si">{</span><span class="n">orphaned</span><span class="si">:</span><span class="s2">,</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2"> pop(s) referencing a point "</span>
              <span class="sa">f</span><span class="s2">"no longer in the file (absorbed during a special demand "</span>
              <span class="sa">f</span><span class="s2">"merge) - these get dropped automatically on save()."</span><span class="p">)</span>

    <span class="k">if</span> <span class="ow">not</span> <span class="n">to_route</span><span class="p">:</span>
        <span class="k">return</span> <span class="mi">0</span>

    <span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="sa">f</span><span class="s2">"  Routing </span><span class="si">{</span><span class="nb">len</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">to_route</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="si">:</span><span class="s2">,</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2"> new pop(s) via OSRM (</span><span class="si">{</span><span class="n">osrm_url</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2">)..."</span><span class="p">)</span>
    <span class="c1"># requests.Session()'s default HTTPAdapter caps its connection pool at 10</span>
    <span class="c1"># (pool_connections/pool_maxsize) regardless of max_workers - without</span>
    <span class="c1"># mounting a bigger pool, most of those threads just queue for one of 10</span>
    <span class="c1"># real connections instead of genuinely running max_workers requests at</span>
    <span class="c1"># once.</span>
    <span class="n">session</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">requests</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">Session</span><span class="p">()</span>
    <span class="n">_adapter</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">requests</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">adapters</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">HTTPAdapter</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">pool_connections</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">max_workers</span><span class="p">,</span>
                                              <span class="n">pool_maxsize</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">max_workers</span><span class="p">)</span>
    <span class="n">session</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">mount</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">"http://"</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">_adapter</span><span class="p">)</span>
    <span class="n">session</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">mount</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">"https://"</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">_adapter</span><span class="p">)</span>

    <span class="c1"># Several landmarks' gravity-sampled pops can end up sharing the exact</span>
    <span class="c1"># same (home, job) point pair - the duration/distance only depends on</span>
    <span class="c1"># those two physical points, never on which pop it is, so resolve each</span>
    <span class="c1"># unique pair once and fan the result out afterward.</span>
    <span class="n">pair_representative</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">{}</span>
    <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">pop</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">to_route</span><span class="p">:</span>
        <span class="n">pair_key</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">(</span><span class="n">pop</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"residenceId"</span><span class="p">],</span> <span class="n">pop</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"jobId"</span><span class="p">])</span>
        <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">pair_key</span> <span class="ow">not</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">pair_representative</span><span class="p">:</span>
            <span class="n">pair_representative</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n">pair_key</span><span class="p">]</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">pop</span>
    <span class="n">unique_pops</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="nb">list</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">pair_representative</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">values</span><span class="p">())</span>

    <span class="k">def</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf">process_table_batch</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">batch</span><span class="p">):</span>
        <span class="n">n</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="nb">len</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">batch</span><span class="p">)</span>
        <span class="n">coords</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">([</span><span class="n">points_by_id</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n">pop</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"residenceId"</span><span class="p">]][</span><span class="s2">"location"</span><span class="p">]</span> <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">pop</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">batch</span><span class="p">]</span>
                  <span class="o">+</span> <span class="p">[</span><span class="n">points_by_id</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n">pop</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"jobId"</span><span class="p">]][</span><span class="s2">"location"</span><span class="p">]</span> <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">pop</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">batch</span><span class="p">])</span>
        <span class="n">coord_str</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="s2">";"</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">join</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="sa">f</span><span class="s2">"</span><span class="si">{</span><span class="n">lon</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2">,</span><span class="si">{</span><span class="n">lat</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2">"</span> <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">lon</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">lat</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">coords</span><span class="p">)</span>
        <span class="n">radii_str</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="s2">";"</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">join</span><span class="p">([</span><span class="s2">"1000"</span><span class="p">]</span> <span class="o">*</span> <span class="nb">len</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">coords</span><span class="p">))</span>
        <span class="n">sources</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="s2">";"</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">join</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="nb">str</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">i</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">i</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="nb">range</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">n</span><span class="p">))</span>
        <span class="n">destinations</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="s2">";"</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">join</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="nb">str</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">i</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">i</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="nb">range</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">n</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="mi">2</span> <span class="o">*</span> <span class="n">n</span><span class="p">))</span>
        <span class="n">url</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">(</span><span class="sa">f</span><span class="s2">"</span><span class="si">{</span><span class="n">osrm_url</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2">/table/v1/driving/</span><span class="si">{</span><span class="n">coord_str</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2">"</span>
               <span class="sa">f</span><span class="s2">"?sources=</span><span class="si">{</span><span class="n">sources</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2">&amp;destinations=</span><span class="si">{</span><span class="n">destinations</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2">"</span>
               <span class="sa">f</span><span class="s2">"&amp;annotations=duration,distance&amp;radiuses=</span><span class="si">{</span><span class="n">radii_str</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2">"</span><span class="p">)</span>
        <span class="k">try</span><span class="p">:</span>
            <span class="n">response</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">session</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">get</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">url</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">timeout</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="mf">15.0</span><span class="p">)</span>
            <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">response</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">status_code</span> <span class="o">!=</span> <span class="mi">200</span><span class="p">:</span>
                <span class="k">return</span> <span class="p">{},</span> <span class="n">batch</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="p">[]</span>
            <span class="n">resp_data</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">response</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">json</span><span class="p">()</span>
            <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">resp_data</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">get</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">"code"</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="o">!=</span> <span class="s2">"Ok"</span><span class="p">:</span>
                <span class="k">return</span> <span class="p">{},</span> <span class="n">batch</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="p">[]</span>
            <span class="n">durations</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">resp_data</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">get</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">"durations"</span><span class="p">)</span>
            <span class="n">distances</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">resp_data</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">get</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">"distances"</span><span class="p">)</span>
            <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">durations</span> <span class="ow">is</span> <span class="kc">None</span> <span class="ow">or</span> <span class="n">distances</span> <span class="ow">is</span> <span class="kc">None</span><span class="p">:</span>
                <span class="k">return</span> <span class="p">{},</span> <span class="n">batch</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="p">[]</span>
        <span class="k">except</span> <span class="n">requests</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">RequestException</span><span class="p">:</span>
            <span class="k">return</span> <span class="p">{},</span> <span class="n">batch</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="p">[]</span>

        <span class="n">resolved</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">{}</span>
        <span class="n">fallback_pops</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">[]</span>
        <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">i</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">pop</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="nb">enumerate</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">batch</span><span class="p">):</span>
            <span class="n">pair_key</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">(</span><span class="n">pop</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"residenceId"</span><span class="p">],</span> <span class="n">pop</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"jobId"</span><span class="p">])</span>
            <span class="n">d_sec</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">durations</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n">i</span><span class="p">][</span><span class="n">i</span><span class="p">]</span>
