            <span class="n">d_dist</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">distances</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n">i</span><span class="p">][</span><span class="n">i</span><span class="p">]</span>
            <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">d_sec</span> <span class="ow">is</span> <span class="kc">None</span> <span class="ow">or</span> <span class="n">d_dist</span> <span class="ow">is</span> <span class="kc">None</span><span class="p">:</span>
                <span class="c1"># This specific pair has no road route - straight-line</span>
                <span class="c1"># fallback for just this pair, not a whole-batch retry.</span>
                <span class="n">fallback_pops</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">append</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">pop</span><span class="p">)</span>
            <span class="k">else</span><span class="p">:</span>
                <span class="n">resolved</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n">pair_key</span><span class="p">]</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">(</span><span class="nb">int</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">d_sec</span><span class="p">),</span> <span class="nb">int</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">d_dist</span><span class="p">))</span>
        <span class="k">return</span> <span class="n">resolved</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="p">[],</span> <span class="n">fallback_pops</span>

    <span class="n">resolved_by_pair</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">{}</span>
    <span class="n">batches</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">[</span><span class="n">unique_pops</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n">i</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="n">i</span> <span class="o">+</span> <span class="n">batch_size</span><span class="p">]</span> <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">i</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="nb">range</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="nb">len</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">unique_pops</span><span class="p">),</span> <span class="n">batch_size</span><span class="p">)]</span>
    <span class="n">pending_batches</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">batches</span>
    <span class="n">attempt</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="mi">1</span>

    <span class="k">while</span> <span class="n">pending_batches</span><span class="p">:</span>
        <span class="n">failed_batches</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">[]</span>
        <span class="n">completed_pairs</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="mi">0</span>
        <span class="k">with</span> <span class="n">ThreadPoolExecutor</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">max_workers</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">max_workers</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="k">as</span> <span class="n">executor</span><span class="p">:</span>
            <span class="n">futures</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">[</span><span class="n">executor</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">submit</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">process_table_batch</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">b</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">b</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">pending_batches</span><span class="p">]</span>
            <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">future</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">as_completed</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">futures</span><span class="p">):</span>
                <span class="n">resolved</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">retry_batch</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">fallback_pops</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">future</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">result</span><span class="p">()</span>
                <span class="n">resolved_by_pair</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">update</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">resolved</span><span class="p">)</span>
                <span class="n">completed_pairs</span> <span class="o">+=</span> <span class="nb">len</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">resolved</span><span class="p">)</span>
                <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">retry_batch</span><span class="p">:</span>
                    <span class="n">failed_batches</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">append</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">retry_batch</span><span class="p">)</span>
                <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">pop</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">fallback_pops</span><span class="p">:</span>
                    <span class="n">h</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">points_by_id</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n">pop</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"residenceId"</span><span class="p">]]</span>
                    <span class="n">j</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">points_by_id</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n">pop</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"jobId"</span><span class="p">]]</span>
                    <span class="n">dist</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">math</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">hypot</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">h</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"location"</span><span class="p">][</span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">]</span> <span class="o">-</span> <span class="n">j</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"location"</span><span class="p">][</span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">],</span>
                                       <span class="n">h</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"location"</span><span class="p">][</span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">]</span> <span class="o">-</span> <span class="n">j</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"location"</span><span class="p">][</span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">])</span> <span class="o">*</span> <span class="mi">111000</span>
                    <span class="n">resolved_by_pair</span><span class="p">[(</span><span class="n">pop</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"residenceId"</span><span class="p">],</span> <span class="n">pop</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"jobId"</span><span class="p">])]</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">(</span><span class="nb">int</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">dist</span> <span class="o">/</span> <span class="mf">8.3</span><span class="p">),</span> <span class="nb">int</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">dist</span><span class="p">))</span>
                <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">completed_pairs</span> <span class="ow">and</span> <span class="n">completed_pairs</span> <span class="o">%</span> <span class="mi">5000</span> <span class="o">&lt;</span> <span class="n">batch_size</span><span class="p">:</span>
                    <span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="sa">f</span><span class="s2">"    -&gt; Resolved </span><span class="si">{</span><span class="n">completed_pairs</span><span class="si">:</span><span class="s2">,</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2"> / </span><span class="si">{</span><span class="nb">len</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">unique_pops</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="si">:</span><span class="s2">,</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2"> unique pair(s) in this pass..."</span><span class="p">)</span>

        <span class="k">if</span> <span class="ow">not</span> <span class="n">failed_batches</span><span class="p">:</span>
            <span class="k">break</span>

        <span class="k">if</span> <span class="nb">len</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">failed_batches</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="o">==</span> <span class="nb">len</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">pending_batches</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="ow">or</span> <span class="n">attempt</span> <span class="o">&gt;=</span> <span class="n">max_retry_passes</span><span class="p">:</span>
            <span class="n">total_failed</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="nb">sum</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="nb">len</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">b</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">b</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">failed_batches</span><span class="p">)</span>
            <span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="sa">f</span><span class="s2">"  [WARNING] </span><span class="si">{</span><span class="n">total_failed</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2"> route(s) couldn't be resolved via OSRM - "</span>
                  <span class="sa">f</span><span class="s2">"falling back to straight-line distance for those."</span><span class="p">)</span>
            <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">batch</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">failed_batches</span><span class="p">:</span>
                <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">pop</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">batch</span><span class="p">:</span>
                    <span class="n">h</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">points_by_id</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n">pop</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"residenceId"</span><span class="p">]]</span>
                    <span class="n">j</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">points_by_id</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n">pop</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"jobId"</span><span class="p">]]</span>
                    <span class="n">dist</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">math</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">hypot</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">h</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"location"</span><span class="p">][</span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">]</span> <span class="o">-</span> <span class="n">j</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"location"</span><span class="p">][</span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">],</span>
                                       <span class="n">h</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"location"</span><span class="p">][</span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">]</span> <span class="o">-</span> <span class="n">j</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"location"</span><span class="p">][</span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">])</span> <span class="o">*</span> <span class="mi">111000</span>
                    <span class="n">resolved_by_pair</span><span class="p">[(</span><span class="n">pop</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"residenceId"</span><span class="p">],</span> <span class="n">pop</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"jobId"</span><span class="p">])]</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">(</span><span class="nb">int</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">dist</span> <span class="o">/</span> <span class="mf">8.3</span><span class="p">),</span> <span class="nb">int</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">dist</span><span class="p">))</span>
            <span class="k">break</span>

        <span class="n">pending_batches</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">failed_batches</span>
        <span class="n">attempt</span> <span class="o">+=</span> <span class="mi">1</span>

    <span class="c1"># Fan each pair's resolved result back out to every pop sharing that pair.</span>
    <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">pop</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">to_route</span><span class="p">:</span>
        <span class="n">seconds</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">distance</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">resolved_by_pair</span><span class="p">[(</span><span class="n">pop</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"residenceId"</span><span class="p">],</span> <span class="n">pop</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"jobId"</span><span class="p">])]</span>
        <span class="n">pop</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"drivingSeconds"</span><span class="p">]</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">seconds</span>
        <span class="n">pop</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"drivingDistance"</span><span class="p">]</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">distance</span>

    <span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="sa">f</span><span class="s2">"  -&gt; Routed </span><span class="si">{</span><span class="nb">len</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">to_route</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="si">:</span><span class="s2">,</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2"> pop(s)."</span><span class="p">)</span>
    <span class="k">return</span> <span class="nb">len</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">to_route</span><span class="p">)</span>
</pre></div></td></tr></table></div>

      </section>
    </main>
  </div>
